evidence.title: DESIGN.md - Design Systems for AI Coding

name: DESIGNmd
summary: Library of 400+ free DESIGN.md design systems that AI coding tools read to build consistent, on-brand UI.
description: DESIGNmd hosts community-made DESIGN.md files: the Google-published plain-text format that gives coding agents a design system, with tokens in YAML front matter and markdown sections for colors, typography, layout, elevation, shapes and components. Browse systems by tag and drop one into a project, or install the MCP server (7 tools) or the npm CLI so an agent can search and download them.
contains: browse by tag: saas, dark, minimal, bold, dashboard, landing page, mobile app
DESIGN.md spec published by Google (alpha); every uploaded kit is linted
MCP server with 7 tools and ~2K tokens of context
CLI via npm or npx designmd, with JSON output
free API key required to download systems
